claimed_coverage: Tests that the Schools::UsageController#show action validates supply and period parameters, returning success for valid values (electricity/daily) and redirect for invalid values.

issue_context_used: The issue.md describes the need for robust validation of supply and period parameters to prevent security warnings and runtime errors.
notes: Eval script uses test.patch to inject the test file and factory trait. The test verifies both valid parameter handling (returns success) and invalid parameter handling (returns redirect instead of raising exception).
